question: Is the transported entry12 rank-two span selectively necessary and sufficient at the final residual state, and can its causal payload be interchanged between the A1 and A2 constructions?

prior_art.known_lessons: Complete-state swaps are tautological; a subspace claim requires projection removal/sufficiency. Basis columns have rotational gauge and must not be named individually. The selective gold router keeps P/C off, while the learned lexical gate is not OOD.
prior_art.novelty: Manipulate the transported rank-two span immediately before the exact nonlinear decoder, and interchange whole projected payloads between paired A1/A2 rows without assigning semantics to arbitrary basis columns.

frozen_design.states: Reconstruct opposite-fold entry12 unions and the gold A1/A2/off routed program. Capture native-off and routed-on final states through the full live suffix; also preserve the direct frozen-write final states from the identified route.
frozen_design.removal: At the final state compute delta_parallel=(on-off)UU^T. Evaluate on-delta_parallel through the exact final RMSNorm/tied-unembedding/soft-cap head. No refit or logit optimization.
frozen_design.sufficiency: Evaluate off+delta_parallel through the same exact head and score against the full routed target response.
frozen_design.construction_swap: Within each group, exchange the complete projected final-state payload between its A1 and A2 rows, leave P/C at off, and decode. Score each target against its own full routed response; this tests shared payload reuse without identifying individual coordinates.
frozen_design.controls: Require rank-two geometry replay, exact native/full head replay, orthogonality, paired-group inventory, finite metrics, zero P/C changes, and literal price. Report live-suffix and frozen-write variants separately.
